title: SBOM-driven delta-sync and verified bundle installer for air-gapped sites
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce SBOM-driven delta sync for sealed bundles; add verified extraction path that enforces SBOM and signature checks; Terraform helper to seed local registry with SBOM-index; Helm pre-install hook that validates bundle provenance; rollout is backwards-compatible with existing offline bundles (no forced upgrade).
body: Motivation: air-gapped installs increasingly require stronger supply-chain verification and smaller upgrade windows. Existing installer bundles pull full OCI images for every upgrade which is expensive for large on-prem fleets. This PR implements an SBOM-driven delta-sync path and a verified extraction flow so offline bundles are applied only for layers that changed and only after provenance checks. Summary: 1) Generate and consume CycloneDX SBOMs per bundle artifact and ship a compact index in the sealed bundle; 2) A delta-sync engine that compares local registry state (layer digest set) against bundle SBOM and fetches only missing/changed layers; 3) Verified extraction: signature (cosign) verification + SBOM checksum validation before writing runtime artifacts; 4) Terraform module update to support 'sbom_index' seeding to local registries during bootstrap; 5) Helm chart hook for installer that blocks apply until verification succeeds; 6) New installer CLI flags (--sbom-verify, --delta-sync-only, --sbom-cache-dir) and preflight checks for KMS key presence. Design notes: - SBOM format chosen: CycloneDX v1.4 with additional vendor extension carrying OCI layer digests to avoid full image manifests. This keeps the on-device index compact (~10-100KB per bundle). - Delta algorithm: compute symmetric difference of layer digest sets, fetch in parallel with backoff and resume on failure. - Security: cosign signatures are validated against configured root certificates (support for KMS/HSM signing is in separate PR but the verification hook supports PKIX chains). - Backwards compat: if no SBOM present or --sbom-verify disabled, installer falls back to existing full-extract path. - Rollback: installer records applied delta IDs in /var/lib/redwood-installer/applied-deltas.json and supports the existing rollback hook. Usage: Examples included in README change: redwood-installer apply --bundle sealed-bundle.tar.gz --sbom-verify --sbom-cache-dir /var/cache/rwi/sbom --delta-sync-only To seed a local registry during bootstrap (Terraform): module "registry_seed" { source = "github.com/redwood/private-installer//terraform/registry-seed" bundle_sbom_index = "path/to/index.json" } Testing: unit tests for SBOM parsing and delta set diff (coverage added in pkg/sbom/*), integration tests run in CI smoke job using a small sealed bundle with three images. CI: initial run hit a flaky e2e related to partial pull timeouts; added retry logic and extended network mock timeouts, all checks now pass. Migration: existing sealed bundles without SBOM continue to work. We recommend re-publishing bundles with SBOM when teams are preparing upgrades to reduce bandwidth. Limitations: current SBOM index is per-bundle; federated index across many bundles is future work. Implementation details: - New packages: pkg/sbom (parsing/validation), pkg/deltasync (delta calculation + fetcher), cmd/installer (new flags + verified extraction orchestrator). - Helm: charts/installer/templates/hooks/verify-preinstall.yaml blocks install until the installer sidecar reports verification success. - Terraform: terraform/registry-seed adds a small helper that reads an index.json and pushes missing blobs to a local registry using skopeo/oras. - Docs: docs/airgap/sbom-index.md with examples, and upgrade notes.
commits: 1) add pkg/sbom parser and tests; 2) implement deltasync engine with resume and backoff; 3) installer CLI flags and verified extraction flow; 4) helm preinstall hook and chart changes; 5) terraform registry-seed module; 6) integration tests and CI adjustments
comments: Luca Ortega (review): Nice approach — can you clarify failure modes when cosign roots are missing? We should fail fast in the preflight instead of halfway through extraction.
Maya Chen (author): Good point — added a preflight KMS/cosign root check and made verified extraction a blocking step in the helm hook. See installer preflight changes in cmd/installer/main.go.
Priya Iyer (review): Terraform module looks good but please add an option to skip skopeo and use a preseeded tarball for air-gapped environments with stricter egress policies.
Maya Chen (author): Added 'use_local_tarball' boolean and updated README with tarball usage and examples.
Evan Park (approval): Integration tests exercise the delta path and rollback; satisfied with retry/backoff changes. APPROVED
CI Bot: initial pipeline failed on e2e:timeout (network mock). Rerun triggered.
CI Bot: pipeline passed on rerun. All checks green.
merge_commit_message: SBOM-driven delta sync + verified bundle installer (squash): adds SBOM index consumption, delta fetch engine, verified extraction orchestration, helm preinstall verification hook, and terraform registry-seed helper. Includes tests and docs.
notes_for_backport: No API changes; backport to release/2026-Q1 only if customer reports immediate need for SBOM verification. Backport will require including cosign dependency in vendor tree for older toolchains.
